verified_findings: API returns orders in descending order (newest to oldest).
Sync must terminate early upon encountering orders older than cutoff date (POS365_SYNC_FROM_DATE).
Paging must cap at POS365_SYNC_MAX_PAGES to prevent network starvation and worker timeouts.
Field mapping verified: Code -> doc_code, PurchaseDate -> created_at, TotalPayment -> paid, Total -> total, Discount -> discount, Pos/RoomId -> table_name, NumberOfGuests -> guests.
security_note: No credentials, tokens, cookies, or secrets are retained in this artifact.
